purpose: Teach: 邦訳/自由民主党/自由党/角川書店/講じる/可用性/外為/用水

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外論文の邦訳に挑戦しろ
lines.en: Ren, take on translating an overseas paper into Japanese.
lines.style: Direct but not unkind. Brief statement of expectation. Slight pause after the name — registering him, assigning the task. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone who believes you can do it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。自由民主党所属の議員と勉強会で議論しました
lines.en: Yes. I discussed it with a Diet member from the Liberal Democratic Party at a study session.
lines.style: Quick, eager to show he's already engaged. Slight brightness on the facts — pride in preparation, not arrogance. Formal register but genuine. Eyes forward, ready.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、自由党時代の歴史を研究しろ
lines.en: Then research the history of the Liberal Party era.
lines.style: Follow-up task, not a question. Measured delivery. Slight emphasis on 'Liberal Party era' — narrowing the scope for him. The tone of someone building on what he's already shown.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。角川書店からの執筆依頼を受けました
lines.en: Yes. I've already received a writing commission from Kadokawa Publishers.
lines.style: Respectful but with quiet confidence. Quick delivery on the news. Not breathless — matter-of-fact. He's done the work before telling his boss.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究中の問題に対策を講じるつもりだ
lines.en: Ren, I intend to put countermeasures in place for the problems you're running into in your research.
lines.style: Supportive shift in tone. Less directive, more collaborative. Slower than before — he's signaling he's listening, not just assigning. Slight warmth underneath the formal register.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究データの可用性を確認しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm currently verifying the availability of research data.
lines.style: Methodical, thorough. Steady tempo. Shows he's not waiting passively — he's already investigating. Formal but grounded. The voice of someone who does his homework.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、外為市場の研究も学会論文で扱いました
lines.en: Ren, I've also handled foreign exchange market research in an academic paper.
lines.style: Shift to demonstration mode — he's showing Ren the breadth of what's been done before. Slight leisureliness in delivery, not rushed. Pride in the work, delivered without boasting. An opening for Ren to see the scope.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。海外調査では用水確保にも注意します
lines.en: Yes. In overseas fieldwork, I'll also be careful to secure adequate water supplies.
lines.style: Careful, thorough-minded. Acknowledging a practical reality Hiroshi just raised. Respectful close — brief, professional. The voice of someone wrapping up, ready to move forward.
